system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Landsat Collection 2 Tier 1 Level 2 Annual NDVI Composite

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land coverage at 30 m, including the boreal forest, wetland and cold-temperate terrain of the Greater Khingan Mountains in northeastern China

analytical_capabilities: Vegetation greenness monitoring at the scale of individual forest stands and land parcels
Multi-decadal interannual vegetation trend analysis on a fixed annual step
Vegetation disturbance and recovery detection at 30 m
Stratification of vegetation state by elevation belt, slope class, aspect, or land-cover type
Association analysis against coarser gridded climate variables after resampling

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI as a dimensionless index ranging from -1.0 to 1.0
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the single `NDVI` band directly; values are already physical and carry no scale factor. Each image composites every scene acquired in that calendar year, keeping the most recent valid pixel, so a year with sparse cloud-free coverage may be represented by observations from an unrepresentative season. Check per-year image availability over the area of interest before building trend series, and note that the annual step means within-year phenology is not recoverable.

data_description.data_source: USGS, derived from Landsat Collection 2 Tier 1 Level 2 surface reflectance
